title: The Secret
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Jim confides in Michael about his past feelings for Pam, asking him to keep it a secret, while Dwight investigates Oscar's suspicious illness. Michael struggles with the responsibility of holding Jim's secret and tries to support Jim through a lunch outing. Meanwhile, Pam prepares for her wedding, and tensions rise as secrets and investigations unfold within the office.

main_threads.thread: Jim reveals his long-standing crush on Pam to Michael and later to Pam herself, creating a secret that Michael promises to keep.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Remember that thing I told you on the booze cruise about Pam? That… was… personal so if we can just keep that between you and me.
Jim: Hey oh, listen, um, I told Michael on the booze cruise. It's so stupid. Um, I told Michael that I had had a crush on you when you first started here.
Pam: No, I know, like, I kind of like, I thought that maybe you did when I first started.

main_threads.thread: Dwight suspects Oscar is faking being sick, conducts an investigation, and uses the information as leverage for a favor.

evidence.snippet:
Dwight: Oscar is out sick.
Michael: On a Friday?
Dwight: Quick Oscar update. I have conducted interviews with everyone in the office.
Dwight: Guess what I found out about Oscar tonight? He was lying about being sick.
Dwight: How bout this. I don't tell Michael and in exchange you owe me one great big giant favor.

main_threads.thread: Michael tries to balance his role as boss and friend, defending his actions and reflecting on the complications of keeping secrets.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Jim and I are great friends. We hang out a ton, mostly at work.
Michael: Why do I like Hooters? Well I will give you two reasons, the boobs and the hot wings.
Michael: I, oh, just, um, I know I was trying to, expense reports. And then God, Toby, you know he just… I know. I'm just, I just hope that, I just hope that this doesn't affect...
Michael: No, I feel it's my responsibility as your boss slash friend.
Michael: People are always coming to me. "Michael, I have a secret. Your the only one I trust." No thanks, because keeping a secret can only lead to trouble.
